After that, could you provide the precipitation statistics for the Amazon rainforest for the past year and then for the past five years?"

We should call the function for Thai: location "New York, NY", cuisine "Thai", max_distance 10. Then Italian: same location, cuisine "Italian", max_distance 10.

Then precipitation stats: location "Amazon rainforest", time_frame "year". Then again for "five_years".
